# Calls that do not meet the following criteria are subject to $0.01 per call short duration penalty:
# 1. Completed calls with less than 6 second duration must be less than 15% of total traffic.
# 2. The average call duration (ACD) for all calls must be 60 seconds or longer.
# 3. The number of incomplete calls must be less than 50% of all calls.
